Robotics Engineer and Space Scientist: The robotics display was full of energy – simulation of playing with futuristic technology. The space theme was beautifully designed.
The event was managed seamlessly, with every detail thoughtfully planned. From the interactive setups to the smooth coordination, everything reflected the hard work and dedication of the school staff. A special mention must go to the parents who contributed their time and effort in creating projects – the results were simply outstanding and added immense value to the event.
Overall, NextGenHelpers was more than just an event; it was an experience that planted seeds of curiosity and imagination in little minds. We are truly grateful to the school for organizing something so enriching at such an early stage of education.
